name: taisly-social-media-posting
title_zh: AI 剪完的竖屏短片，一句话发去五个平台
tagline_zh: Agent 生成完竖屏视频，最烦的是还要人肉登录五个后台、逐个填标题话题。这里给 Agent 一个发布接口。
tagline_en: Your agent finishes a vertical video, then you still log into five dashboards by hand. This gives the agent one.
desc_en: Free AI-first short-form video publishing to TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and Facebook from AI agents through Taisly.
why_zh: 把「发布」这一步也交给 Agent，而不是让它在生成完视频后停下来等你。走 Taisly 托管授权。
why_en: Publishing becomes an agent step instead of a handoff back to you. Taisly holds the platform auth, so you skip applying for each.
limit_zh: 账号得先授权给 Taisly，不是纯本地跑；只覆盖 TikTok、Reels、Shorts、X。
limit_en: Accounts must be authorized through Taisly, so it isn't fully local. Only TikTok, Reels, Shorts, X and Facebook — no Bilibili or Xiaohongshu. Free.
title_en: Publish AI-made short videos to 5 platforms in one call
